objective: Freeze an internally coherent and auditable risk basis before any alpha result is allowed to influence risk-model membership.

alpha_stage_boundary.rule: G6 freezes only the risk model. Every future alpha candidate must explicitly decide beta, residual-volatility, liquidity, and listing-age neutralization; statistical-factor neutralization is forbidden because statistical directions live only in Delta; ALL_RISK is forbidden.

hard_prerequisites: L1 exposure manifest contains the frozen weight_metric_contract and risk_basis_id
G2 independently recomputes orthogonality under the same regression-base artifact and passes
formal G3 risk_basis_id and risk_metric_id exactly match L1/G2
all semantic cost artifacts either match that risk_basis_id or are explicitly superseded

split_gates.parallelism: After G6a, G5/G6b may run in parallel with pre-production alpha research; no optimizer or production risk use is allowed before G6b.

high_r_squared_semantic_overlap_probe.default_interpretation: suspect absorption of prospective economic dimensions before treating high R-squared as improvement

g6_interpretation_statement: A final mean daily weighted R-squared near 0.22 is the explicit price paid to keep value, momentum, growth, and earnings-yield available as alpha dimensions. It is not an incomplete attempt to reproduce a 0.30-plus Barra-style explanatory score.

publication_semantics.not: treat G6 as an abstract irreversible milestone without a versioned publication artifact
publication_semantics.trigger: publish immutable frozen risk-set manifest and update the risk-set current pointer
publication_semantics.alpha_boundary: no alpha candidate may be registered before risk_set_version=1 is published
v2_triggers: a termination clause is explicitly reopened under a new preregistered protocol
publication_semantics.v2_action: issue new risk_basis_id, rerun L1/G2/G3 and basis-scoped gates, publish immutable supersession
